title: Weinstein told the same by multiple unrelated parties
summary: Eric Weinstein tells of Weinstein told the same by multiple unrelated parties, about unspecified at unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So, I've been told the same thing by multiple parties who are not related.

plain: A researcher named Eric Weinstein, speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels, says he has been told the same thing by several different people who have no connection to one another. He does not spell out here what that thing was. If true, it would mean separate sources were backing up the same account on their own.
